title: Cranly’s
html_source:
Useful to discern what’s going on as Stephen unifies many strands and motifs in the whole book in this charming chapter.

The fractured nature of Stephen’s thoughts which we heard in Proteus are absent from this episode in the National Library. In their place are contiguous streams which, with the external narrative,rip into Joyce’s contemporaries.

Throughout the episode, both narratives are loaded into the gun of allusion and reference and fired off at AE, Cranly, Lister and Best.
